notes.title: 16 BIT NIGHTS - News
notes.content:
Hello players,


We have some important news regarding our [b]16 BIT NIGHTS[/b] company's future.


[h1]01 Welcome Back, Commander[/h1]
The game has been released. We also provided a series of updates after release, and the game is now rock solid with a very positive rating.
Unfortunately, the actual sales were under our expectations, and my partner and I had a lot of arguing regarding this, so we decided to [i]"part ways,"[/i] which brings me to the next point.
You can check out the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/


[h1]02 NEW GAME #1[/h1]
My partner will work on a new game without me. He will use the artwork I made for previous Chromosome Evil/Welcome Back Commander games, and he will also use the [b]16 BIT NIGHTS[/b] branding for publishing, so even though we parted ways, we are still working together to some extent.
He plans on experimenting with co-op multiplayer within an extraction squad-based type of gameplay.
More details soon.


[h1]03 NEW GAME #2[/h1]
I will also work on a game, but I don't want to give out spoilers yet other than it will be a new IP with unique squad-based gameplay.
I will also be working on this one with a new partner.
In addition, this year, I will also try to focus more on our YouTube channel and make full playthroughs of our games with commentary.


[h1]04 NEW GAME #3[/h1]
In collaboration with [b]Real Heroes Studio[/b], we would like to announce a big demo update on [b]Desolated District[/b] on 27 April.
This is a fresh take for us since it's our first project as a collaborative effort with another developer studio. We have a minimal involvement rezumed to environment storytelling design, graffiti sprites, polish interface stage, design consultations, and marketing consultation.
The game is a 3D survival crafting with a nice magical touch within a Kowloon Walled City theme.
You can Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/


[h1]05 Lovecraftian Days Fest[/h1]
We would also like to announce that the  [b]Lovecraftian Days [/b]steam festival hosted by Fulqrum publisher has started, and [b]Welcome Back, Commander[/b], along with [b]Chromosome Evil[/b] and [b]Chromosome Evil 2,[/b] are participating.
To celebrate this, we put together a new trailer that highlights some of the Lovecraftian-inspired bosses you can encounter in Welcome Back, Commander.
Trailer link: https://youtu.be/1HYEjJh_0eU
Link to event: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/lovecraftiandays2025


[h1]06 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle[/h1]
For our hardcore fans who would like to support us in the future, we also updated our 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle with a discount on ALL our games:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29954/16_BIT_NIGHTS/




Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: Update #15 BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello Commander,

We have read all the reviews and feedback, and it filled our hearts with joy to see we managed to make so many of you happy.

[b] Because of this, we have made an important decision.[/b]

The new extra content of the game will not be released as a DLC.
Why?
I don't think it's fair to have the initial players who supported our game during the most critical game release phase to have to pay again.

We also don't want to raise the game price because we want this game to be as accessible as possible to everyone.

[h1]So we decided that the new extra content will be released for FREE as part of the main version updates.[/h1]


New roadmap commander:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/d91e1efdcd26205e42e3dbd7cdc1b0554874f54c.png[/img]

How are we going to cut our losses?
Our losses are our own and it is not your responsibility to help us out.
So this is how we will do it:
We will release a very expensive 20$-25$ DLC in the form of an artbook, I will tell you by now, [b]20$ for an artbook is not worth it[/b], and this is why this artbook will be TOTALLY OPTIONAL, it wont bring any value tot he actual game and it is simbolical only for the ones of you who still want to support our studio, think of this DLC as a sort of optional donation. [u]No strains attached.[/u]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now, on to the juicy part.
UPDATE TIME.

We added a lot of stuff that will test your tactical and survival abilities to the max.


Bug Fixes:
- Cannot see the interface because the unit panel does not disappear after I exit skilldex and crafting
- Unit with rifle cannot change it for sniper and LMG (normal 7.7mm weapon pool) 
- Plant killing achievement not working
- CRASH: game crashed when pressing "next" button from the ending movie fast
- BUG: units have strange animation when switching weapons, this also happens after interaction 
- Grenade launched shooting on the opposite side
- Turret upgrade on engineer shows +2Range +1Damage but in the stats bar it shows +Accuracy and +Range.
- The extraction grade does not match the spec bubble line from the ending movie
- Some units have the wrong loadout
- Steam achievement "Kill Destroy 100 infected." is not working


Ballance:
- Engineers encounter range cost,  from 40 to 150
- Mission A and Mission B from end DEFCON 4, that vision custom reduced by 50%
- added final weapon balance(more firepower to some upgrades)
- added final balance for food cost per unit per day for each difficulty setting

- added an additional 1 hunger penalty to the map: police station from DEFCON 4

Extra content:

- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 4 (reward vs penalty)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 3 (big penalty to one vs small penalty to all)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 2 (sacrifice epic moment)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 1 (pay or support the consequences)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/45b523007cb2e7c7e0a95ab2f326715acca0f180.png[/img]


Because we added so much new stuff, some new bugs may appear, but don't be afraid, we are here and we will crush all reported bugs.


This been said, we invite you all to our Discord community if you want to live chat with us, we are never too busy or too arrogant not to talk to our fans.



Soon we will also make an announcement about the future of our studio.










Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: Update #6 BIG CONTENT
notes.content:
Hello Commanders,





Good news or bad news first ?

So let's start with our situation Update, the bad news first.



The release results are far below our expectations.

But even though we received so little support, that little support was [u]AWESOME[/u], we noticed players who already finished the game 7 or 8 times in the first week of release, seeing you so invested in our humble creation with your stories on our Discord made our hearts grow, and for you, FOR YOU we dedicate this EXTRA content update!

I don't know how other indie developers are but for us, the situation is as follows:

notes.title: Hi Players! - Devblog #1
notes.content:
HI Players!

It feels so good to be back in the [b]Steam gaming Coloseum[/b].

[i]For the new players here il do a short introduction, my name is Cristi and I represent half of the team from 16BIT NIGHTS alongside my partner Sadoff, and for the old-timers: Thank you for making this moment possible! And for that one weird guy: please stop emailing me pictures of socks.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/5afdbf7bca307583bce9732134f4431a35006ea2.gif[/img]


[b]Now let's begin with the big guns: What is "Welcome Back, Commander"?[/b]

"Welcome Back, Commander" is the prequel to the "Chromosome Evil" Franchise and can be played independently without knowing the rest of the games.
We are using most of the same art style from previous games but with improvements and all animations were remade again from scratch by my partner Sadoff + many new additions, basically, we are happy with the visual formula and now we are just improving it.
As for the gameplay that will suffer solid changes. Why? To better understand this I need to tell you about our team hierarchy:
- "Chromosome Evil 1" had 60% of my design  and 40% of Sadoff's design
- "Chromosome Evil 2" Sadoff had the final word in the game design decisions
And now :
- "Welcome Back, Commander" I will have the final word in the game design decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/12b896882cacc29843e425345e6372a57c278303.gif[/img]
[i]Can anyone find the Aliens' easter egg?[/i]

Also, the old timers already know this, we have a limited amount of funding, we need to finish this game by a strict deadline, and our funds will last us until this winter("Winter is coming" has a painful Game Of Thrones feel for us), if we will not meet these deadlines we will probably risk a bit and take some loans but the bottom of the line is that this project has just become all or nothing for us and due to this issues we decided to reduce the gameplay time length and invest everything in quality and replayability(multiple paths, multiple endings, multiple ways to play, etc, we want each playthrough to be as unique as possible)- going by "strong essence is kept in small quantity".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/48c32e20c89531d914552af77247430f13465b46.gif[/img]


The gameplay will be split into 2 parts: 
1.[u] tactical:[/u] part: where you control your squad directly in an RTS approach
2. [u]strategic[/u] part: where you make critical decisions and manage your squad skills and equipment

[b]The aim will be to make you the player feel like an actual commander during an apocalyptic event.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/fb0e18d51194ae14b8bf2a7ce6ff45dd488e7610.gif[/img]
[i]Ready for deployment sir![/i]


[b]What do we have so far?[/b]

A small recap on the teaser and intro of the game.
We went for a full animated intro movie and combined it with interactive elements, what you see in the teaser is the actual first 4 minutes of the game as you can see from all the spam I made with the animated gifs hahaha.
You have no idea how hard it was for us to find voice actors with 0 funding but we had a lot of help and support from the "Negrounds" community "Mud & Blood" Community and friends, btw I also recommend you check "Mud & Blood" game, it is also a tactical marvel and the dev Urb is one cool person.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1391530/Mud_and_Blood/

Also special thanks to UkiTakuMuki, the developer of [b]Strain Tactics[/b] (cool game/cool guy, I recommend trying it out on Steam) for this awesome dev blog header!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/621810/Strain_Tactics/



[b]Where are we going?[/b]

The game will have 5 chapters and now we are working on finishing chapter 1, as soon as we have it up and running we are going to release a public demo and participate in the Steam Next Fest.
We added so much love in this small chapter and we are so eager to show it to you, such delights we have to show you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/5c3be3051321ee3c451c17bb389738d3bfd9845e.gif[/img]
[i]The city of Sun Stone is engulfed in chaos.[/i]


This being said expect a unique experience with our new title.

And don't forget to join our Discord for live chat with us and the community.

[url=https://discord.gg/ak5zXQxR7D][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/b95a9df0826941544e5cd50ca515604ed85e50d7.png[/img][/url]
